metadata.title: Sample evaluation target: ITSP.10.033-01 policy samples
metadata.remarks: Not a real system. OSCAL assessment results import an assessment plan, which imports a system security plan; this minimal pair exists so the sample evaluation's results form a valid chain. It describes the manifests in oscal/policy/samples/ and nothing else.

system-characteristics.description: The Kubernetes manifests in oscal/policy/samples/, written to pass or to fail the rules. Not a deployed system.
